hook_lines: This suisai wash is a hit in Japan

chalkboard.title: What People Are Saying
bullets: suisai launched in 2005 under Kanebo (now Kao) — #1 in Japan's face-wash market for 11 straight years, 30M+ units sold
This paste version launched Sep 2025 — 6 months in: 11 Best Cosme awards, 539,000+ units shipped (~269 Tokyo Towers stacked)
Beauty YouTuber Hiro Odagiri's recommendation video sparked the buzz — many @cosme reviews mention buying it because of that video
Formula: 2 enzymes (protease, lipase) + 2 micro-clays (Moroccan lava clay, kaolin) — foam it or apply directly and massage
Reviews are mixed — some miss the original's instant smoothness, but many say it leaves skin moisturized with no tightness

usage_placeholder.description: 실제로 페이스트워시를 손에 덜어 거품 내거나(또는 그대로 발라 마사지) 세안하는 장면. 튜브에서 짜낸 페이스트 질감, 거품망으로 거품 내는 과정, 세안 후 피부 클로즈업 반응 위주. 10~15초 분량이면 충분.
usage_placeholder.xiaohongshu_query: 日本 suisai 洗顔膏 酵素洗顔 试用

quotes.japanese: 洗浄成分と保湿成分をじっくり丁寧に練り込んだペーストタイプで毎日使いやすい仕様になった嬉しい…拭いてお風呂から上がった後も突っ張ってない!!むしろくすみだけすっきり
quotes.translation: It's a paste with cleansing and moisturizing ingredients carefully worked in, so it's easy to use every day, which I love... even right out of the bath, my skin doesn't feel tight at all — if anything, just the dullness clears up.

quotes.japanese: 気になる鼻の黒ずみも簡単綺麗に優しくオフするならこのセット！パウダータイプより断然、泡立てが楽！この泡が肌を包み込むように洗うのが本当に気持ちいいです！
quotes.translation: If you want to gently and easily clear blackheads on your nose, this is the set — foaming it up is way easier than the powder version! The way this foam wraps around your skin while washing genuinely feels great.

quotes.japanese: 弱酸性・低刺激・無香料・無着色なので、安心して使っています。泡で出てくるのが楽です。リピ済です…洗浄力がやや強いに感じる方は、頻度を調整するといいかもしれません。
quotes.translation: It's mildly acidic, low-irritation, fragrance-free, and dye-free, so I use it without worry. Coming out as ready-made foam makes it easy. I've already repurchased... if the cleansing feels a bit strong for you, adjusting how often you use it might help.
